From f457055a7922154bb786e5d55f75b461fa645e9a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Gustavo A. R. Silva" <gustavo@embeddedor.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Oct 2019 12:49:37 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] power: supply: ab8500_charger: Fix inconsistent IS_ERR and
 PTR_ERR

Fix inconsistent IS_ERR and PTR_ERR in ab8500_charger_probe().

The proper pointer to be passed as argument is di->adc_main_charger_c

This bug was detected with the help of Coccinelle.

Fixes: 97ab78bac5d0 ("power: supply: ab8500_charger: Convert to IIO ADC")
Signed-off-by: Gustavo A. R. Silva <gustavo@embeddedor.com>
Reviewed-by: Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Acked-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Sebastian Reichel <sebastian.reichel@collabora.com>

diff --git a/drivers/power/supply/ab8500_charger.c b/drivers/power/supply/ab8500_charger.c
index ff2bb4411a22..8a0f9d769690 100644
--- a/drivers/power/supply/ab8500_charger.c
+++ b/drivers/power/supply/ab8500_charger.c
@@ -3393,7 +3393,7 @@ static int ab8500_charger_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 		if (PTR_ERR(di->adc_main_charger_c) == -ENODEV)
 			return -EPROBE_DEFER;
 		dev_err(&pdev->dev, "failed to get ADC main charger current\n");
-		return PTR_ERR(di->adc_main_charger_v);
+		return PTR_ERR(di->adc_main_charger_c);
 	}
 	di->adc_vbus_v = devm_iio_channel_get(&pdev->dev, "vbus_v");
 	if (IS_ERR(di->adc_vbus_v)) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/power/supply/ab8500_charger.c`**
- The line that returns the error code when the ADC main charger current fails to be retrieved has been modified. 
- The original line:
  ```c
  return PTR_ERR(di->adc_main_charger_v);
  ```
  has been changed to:
  ```c
  return PTR_ERR(di->adc_main_charger_c);
  ```
- This change ensures that the correct pointer (`di->adc_main_charger_c`) is used when checking for errors, addressing the inconsistency in the error handling logic.

### Relationships
- The modification in the `ab8500_charger.c` file directly addresses a bug related to the error handling in the `ab8500_charger_probe()` function. The fix was prompted by a static analysis tool (Coccinelle) that identified the inconsistency between the use of `IS_ERR` and `PTR_ERR`. The change ensures that the error code returned corresponds to the correct ADC channel, thereby improving the reliability of the error reporting mechanism in the driver. This patch is linked to a previous commit (identified by the hash `97ab78bac5d0`) that converted the driver to use IIO ADC, indicating that the issue arose from changes made in that earlier commit.
